correctness.rationale: For odd n>=11, zero-sum nonbasis incidence gives f(t)+f(-t)=-f(0) on all nonzero pairs. The images of the two valid triples {1,2,-3} and {-1,-2,3} force 3f(0)=0. Translation normalization then yields g(0)=0 and g(-t)=-g(t). For each x choose t outside at most nine forbidden residues (possible since n>=11); the three distinct zero-sum triples force g(2x)=2g(x). The distinct-triple relation and the three doubling exceptions imply g(x+y)=g(x)+g(y) for all x,y, so g(i)=ai, a unit. The converse preserves incidence. For smooth cubic configurations, n>=11 points determine the cubic uniquely by Bezout, and projective translations preserve |3O| iff 3Q=O. This establishes the stated Y1(n) to Y0(n) unlabelled quotient, generic degree phi(n)/2 and generic stabilizer order 2gcd(n,3); the n=9 exceptional order36 prevents extrapolation.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace the stated infinite proof or establish correctness of assumptions outside the precise theorem domain.
